# Section 1: Setup
```{r setup}
pkgs <- c("DESeq2", "rtracklayer", "ggplot2", "pheatmap", "RColorBrewer",
          "EnhancedVolcano", "org.Sc.sgd.db", "clusterProfiler", "enrichplot", "apeglm")

# Load each package and remember the ones that are not available
missing <- character()
for (p in pkgs) {
  ok <- suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages(
    require(p, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)))
  if (!ok) missing <- c(missing, p)
}

# Report
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  cat("NOT available:", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("All packages loaded.\n")
}

# Versions of the packages that loaded
print(sapply(setdiff(pkgs, missing), function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p))))
```


```{r load_data}
#1 Read the two tables: counts and metadata
counts <- read.delim("results/counts/count_matrix.tsv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.delim("metadata/samples.tsv")

dim(counts)  # shows dimensions of the counts table
dim(meta)
names(meta) # shows the column names of the metadata table  

colnames(counts) # shows the column names of the counts table
meta$run_accession  # shows the run_accession column of the metadata table

meta <- meta[match(colnames(counts), meta$run_accession), ] # Reorder the metadata table to match the order of the counts table

rownames(meta) <- meta$run_accession  # Set the row names of the metadata table to be the run_accession values

stopifnot(identical(rownames(meta), colnames(counts))) # Check that the row names of the metadata table match the column names of the counts table

meta
table(meta$condition)  # shows the number of samples in each condition

```
